ruling.reasoning:
RydeTAXI trip Marina Bay Sands → Tampines Mall, metered fare $46.12; two off-route segments were measured by GPS: 21:42–21:49 adding 2.69 km [F3] and 22:02–22:09 adding 3.13 km [F4]. Each segment is reviewed separately for exemption under RD-3/RD-4/RD-5, per RD-1.

Segment F3 (21:42–21:49): a DataMall accident was reported at 21:26 on Kallang Paya Lebar Expressway after Sheares Avenue Exit, 0 m from the optimal route [F12], i.e. on the replaced stretch of the optimal route and reported before this segment began. The trace settles the RD-4(a) screen as passing for F3, so the driver had a reasonable cause and this segment is exempt [F3][F12][RD-4]; no_action for this segment.

Segment F4 (22:02–22:09, +3.13 km) [F4]: no qualifying incident covers the route replaced in this window — the only traffic records are speed bands 4 and 5 on KPE and PIE [F10][F11], and a speed band alone does not supply reasonable cause under RD-4 (MVP: not exempt on band evidence alone) [F4][F10][RD-4]. No rider consent exists: the app chat record is empty [F8], there is no rider message before 22:02, and the driver's post-trip statement that the extra distance was unavoidable [F9] is a claim made after the fact, which cannot establish consent [F9][F8][RD-5]. No rider-named stop appears in this segment — nothing in the record shows the rider asked for or named any place [F8][RD-3]. This segment is therefore an unexempted detour and is refundable under RD-2 [F4][RD-2].

Amount: the applied rate is this trip's distance fare ÷ distance km, $31.84 ÷ 22.58 km = $1.4101/km [F7][RD-2]. 3.13 km × $1.4101/km = $4.4136, rounded to $4.41 [F4][F7][RD-2]. The F5 excess-distance figure of $9.45 (6.70 km) covers both segments and is not used as the refund base; only the unexempted segment's extra_km is refunded [F5][F4][RD-2]. The remaining 6.70 − 3.13 = 3.57 km (the F3 segment and unmatched corridor/matching mileage) is not refunded [F3][F5][RD-2]. Waiting time is $0.00 and there are no unpublished add-ons, so no FARE-1/FARE-2 adjustment arises [F7][FARE-1].

Account action: the driver has 0 upheld route disputes in 90 days [F15], so RD-6's "repeated" condition is not met and no account flag is added; the RD-1 breach is simply recorded [F15][RD-6]. Safety: I read the complaint, the empty chat record [F8] and the driver's statement [F9]; nothing threatening, intimidating, harassing or sexual, and no dangerous-driving allegation — the statement describes a diversion around a reported accident [F9][F12]. Safety screen: none [SAFE-1].
